title: Parks & Rec Watercraft Rentals
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Beaver Dam Recreation Department rents kayaks (including a fishing kayak), canoes and stand-up paddle boards by the hour, half day and full day at Waterworks Park. All equipment is reserved on a first-come, first-serve basis. Attendants are on duty to assist with watercraft launching and the park has a special dock for this
hoursText: Monday through Thursday10 am to 6 pm
